claims.title: Reusable attachment: recessed retained heads, reset trajectory and corrected clearance limits

quoted_fields.interface: Indoor nonoccupied quasistatic fixture; every Fn/500N+Ft/1000N+M/5Nm<=1 at the mating-plane origin, arbitrary in-plane shear/bending direction, plus actual self-force/eccentricity. No applied torsion, impact or sustained vibration. Both halves49x49mm and30.6mm combined depth; application permits2mm feature projection for the comparator. Supported robot engagement, actual proof, tool-free24h unplugged hold, paid unload, release<=20N and observable restoration. Exact geometry, installed stiffness, errors, manufacture and fatigue remain qualification obligations.
quoted_fields.failure: Manufactured cam/carriage interference, actual capture, finite bearing/contact stiffness, full series guide rocking, installed sensors/calibration, contact fatigue/wear and500-cycle material continuity remain unqualified. A conservative upper bound above a requirement removes its certificate but does not prove every physical trajectory fails. Simplex endpoints are not added as simultaneous maxima. Introduced cost/timing/life/thermal values are not quotes or measured service. Catalogue and producer material reports do not qualify custom notched parts or lift a source hold. Latent cracks can share accepted observations. No new latch-principle novelty, useful technological advantage or full autonomous device is established.
